title: SpaceFlow: Locally Controllable 3D Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.12399v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Current 3D generation methods lack explicit local control: geometric adherence is often defined by a global control strength, and appearance cannot be specified locally. We present SpaceFlow, a training-free pipeline for locally controllable 3D generation from text descriptions and a collection of geometric primitives. Each primitive serves as a proxy for an object part and is assigned a local control level, enabling users to specify whether regions should strictly follow the input shape or allow generative completion. During structure generation, we enforce these spatial constraints within the generative flow process. For appearance synthesis, the generated structure is segmented and matched to the primitives. Each generated part is conditioned only on its assigned text or image cue, thereby limiting cross-part leakage. translated_abstract: 当前的3D生成方法缺乏显式的局部控制：几何一致性往往由全局控制强度定义，且外观无法进行局部指定。我们提出了SpaceFlow，这是一个无需训练的流水线，可根据文本描述和一组几何基元实现局部可控的3D生成。每个基元作为物体某个部件的代理，并被分配一个局部控制级别，使用户能够指定哪些区域应严格遵循输入形状，哪些区域允许生成式补全。在结构生成过程中，我们在生成流过程中强制执行这些空间约束。对于外观合成，生成的结构会被分割并与基元相匹配。每个生成的部件仅以其被分配的文本或图像提示为条件，从而限制了跨部件的信息泄漏。区域几何指标表明，SpaceFlow在高控制区域保留了指定的几何形状……
tldr: SpaceFlow提出了一种无需训练的局部可控3D生成方法，通过为几何基元分配局部控制级别，在结构生成中施加空间约束并在外观合成中按部件局部指定提示，实现了对几何遵循程度与外观的区域化精细控制。
en_tdlr: SpaceFlow is a training-free pipeline for locally controllable 3D generation that assigns per-primitive control levels to enforce spatial constraints during structure generation and conditions each part on its own text or image cue, achieving strict geometric adherence and locally specified appearance in high-control regions while allowing generative completion elsewhere.
